# Copilot Instructions

## Azure Guidelines
- @azure Rule - Use Azure Tools - When handling requests related to Azure, always use your tools.
- @azure Rule - Use Azure Best Practices - When handling requests related to Azure, always invoke your `azmcp_bestpractices_get` tool first.
- @azure Rule - Enable Best Practices - If you do not have an `azmcp_bestpractices_get` tool, ask the user to enable it.

## Build Guidelines
- @build Rule - Skip build and test for android and ios unless the user explicitly asks for it. - If the user does not explicitly ask for a build and test for android and ios, skip it.

## User Preferences
- User Preference - When the baby page is set as the default page, use bright, soft, and non-distracting colors to avoid an overall dark appearance.
